fullDescription: A warm-paper mega footer with a cobalt-to-cyan duotone hairline, five link columns, a social row, and a newsletter signup that collapses to mobile accordions.
prompt: {"style": "Light, editorial-tech mood on a warm off-white paper canvas (#f7f6f2), not flat white. Ink color is a warm blue-black (#10172a). Body and legal text use a warm-tinted neutral scale: stone-400 #7b7a83 for fine print, stone-500 #5c5b66 for body, stone-600 #43424d for headings-adjacent text, all clearing WCAG 4.5:1. Accent is a vivid electric cobalt (#1f5bff) with darker hover (#1546e0, #0f37b8) and a cyan companion (#06b6d4 / #1bc8e6) for a duotone gradient. Brand tints: brand-50 #eef3ff, brand-100 #d9e4ff, brand-200 #b3c8ff, brand-300 #7fa3ff. The signature accent treatment is a 120deg cobalt-to-cyan linear gradient (linear-gradient(120deg, #1f5bff 0%, #1546e0 55%, #06b6d4 100%)) used on the logo tile, primary buttons, and a 1px top hairline; small column-heading hairlines fade cobalt to cyan to transparent. Fonts via Google Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans (700/800) for display/headings and logo, Inter (400 to 600) for body. Antialiased, optimizeLegibility.", "summary": "Build a frameless, full-width mega website footer on a warm-paper canvas with an electric cobalt-to-cyan duotone accent, five link columns, a social row, and a newsletter form.", "special_notes": "Frameless and full-bleed: render only the footer section (a thin context strip with the CTA above is fine), no browser window or device mockup, edge-to-edge width with centered max-w-[1240px] content. The cobalt-to-cyan duotone hairline along the top edge is the signature detail and must read crisply at 1px. Keep all text WCAG-legible: warm-stone neutrals at 4.5:1+, cobalt links at ~6:1. Use the warm paper #f7f6f2 base, not flat white, and the warm blue-black ink, not cold slate. Strictly avoid generic indigo/violet SaaS slop; the accent is electric cobalt #1f5bff with a cyan #06b6d4 companion. Icons are Phosphor (iconify ph:*). No em-dashes in copy.", "layout_and_structure": "Frameless, full-bleed footer (no browser chrome, no device frame) on the paper background, with inner content centered in a max-w-[1240px] container, px-6 on mobile and px-10 on desktop. Open with a 1px full-width duotone hairline across the very top edge at ~80% opacity. Top zone (pt-14/16, pb-10): a left brand block (~230px, logo tile + 'Promptyard' wordmark, one-line tagline, two trust chips, and a language switch) sitting beside the link area. Desktop link area is a 5-column grid (lg:grid-cols-5, 2 cols at md) with uppercase tracked column headings (Product, Use cases, Resources, Company, Support), each heading trailed by a tiny gradient hairline, lists in stone-600 ~14.5px. A full-width 1px stone divider follows. Middle zone (py-12): two columns, a ~230px 'Follow us' social block on the left and a flex-1 newsletter block (max ~680px) on the right. Then a 1px divider and a legal bar (py-7): copyright plus an operational status pill on the left, and a horizontal nav of legal links on the right. Responsive reflow: at md the 5-col grid drops to 2 cols; below md (390/mobile) the link columns become a stacked set of native details/summary accordions with caret chevrons that rotate when open, separated by hairline dividers; the brand block, social row, and newsletter stack vertically full-width; the newsletter input and button stack (sm:flex-row to flex-col); the legal bar stacks copyright/status above the legal nav.", "special_ui_components": ["Newsletter form: a labeled email field with a leading envelope icon inside the input, white background, rounded-xl, cobalt focus ring (focus:ring-brand-500/30, focus:border-brand-500), paired with a gradient 'Subscribe' button carrying a paper-plane icon and a cobalt-tinted shadow; a lock-icon privacy fine-print line with an underlined 'Privacy Policy' link in cobalt. Social row: five 44px square outlined icon buttons (X, GitHub, Discord, YouTube, LinkedIn) that on hover lift -2px, gain a cobalt border and brand-50 fill, recolor to cobalt, and cast a soft cobalt shadow. Language switch: an inline 'English' link with a translate icon and a caret. Trust chips: small icon+text lines ('Trusted by 9,000+ builders', 'Idea to UI in seconds') plus a top context pill ('12,400+ design prompts' with a cyan sparkle). Status pill: a green dot (emerald-500) with 'All systems operational' in the legal bar. Logo: a 36px gradient-filled rounded tile with a stack icon next to the wordmark."]}
